flows.narrative: No fresher weekly BofA/EPFR print has landed since the week-ended-Oct-7 edition, so last week's picture still stands: a record $166.4B into money-market funds (largest since April 2020), bonds +$33.8B, and global equity funds +$12.4B (US equities +$3.3B, first inflow in three weeks; EM +$2.1B, second straight week; Japan -$3.3B, its biggest outflow since May; Gold ETFs +$2.0B). Separately, ICI's combined long-term-fund-plus-ETF release for the same week ended Oct 7 turned genuinely positive (+$12.35bn combined, vs the prior week's -$1.97bn), a tentative stabilization signal, though Vanda Research's VandaTrack shows retail single-stock net buying at its weakest pace since the Covid era -- the stabilization is not being driven by retail re-engagement. The next BofA/EPFR edition (week ended Oct 14, capturing this week's hot-CPI selloff) is due ~Oct 16-17.
